blocks.content: Add a small text prompt that appears at the bottom of the canvas while the ball is waiting on the paddle.
In game.js, add a drawLaunchHint(ctx) method that draws "Click or Space to launch" centered at the bottom of the canvas.

items: Set textAlign = "center", textBaseline = "middle", fillStyle = "#aaa", font = "14px Segoe UI".

blocks.content: In draw(), call this.drawLaunchHint(ctx) when this.state === STATE.PLAYING && !this.ball.isLaunched.
